# GoPeek

> GoPeek is a mobile-first portfolio builder for Malaysian freelancers. Build a professional, shareable portfolio in 5 minutes — free forever, no design skills required.

## What GoPeek does

GoPeek lets freelancers (designers, developers, photographers, writers, videographers, etc.) create a public portfolio page at `gopeek.my/<username>`. The portfolio includes a cover photo, profile photo, bio, social links, and tabbed project sections with gallery images, videos, and experience entries. A built-in WhatsApp/email lead capture button (floating action button) lets clients contact the freelancer instantly. Visitors can leave emoji reactions on any portfolio page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://gopeek.my/) — Product overview, features, and sign-up CTA
- [Discovery](https://gopeek.my/discovery) — Public directory of all published freelancer portfolios; shows profile cards with name, title, bio, slug, and top emoji reactions
- [Pricing](https://gopeek.my/pricing) — Plan comparison: Free (RM 0) vs Publish (RM 19/mo) vs Pro (coming soon)
- [Docs](https://gopeek.my/docs) — Step-by-step guide to building and publishing a portfolio
- [Privacy Policy](https://gopeek.my/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://gopeek.my/terms)

## Portfolio pages

Each published portfolio is accessible at `gopeek.my/<slug>` (e.g. `gopeek.my/sulaimanshafiq`). Portfolios include:
- Cover photo (optional, full-width banner)
- Profile photo and avatar
- Name, professional title, bio
- Social links (Instagram, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Email, Website, YouTube, GitHub, TikTok, Behance, Dribbble)
- Tabbed content sections (Work, Portfolio, etc.) containing gallery blocks, video blocks, and experience blocks
- Light / dark theme (set by the portfolio owner; visitors can toggle locally)
- Emoji reactions (❤️ 🔥 👏 😍 🚀 ✨) — any visitor can react; counts are shown in real time
- Contact FAB (floating action button) — tapping opens a sheet to contact the creator via WhatsApp, email, or phone
- GoPeek badge on free-tier portfolios

## Plans

| Plan    | Price              | Key features |
|---------|--------------------|--------------|
| Free    | RM 0 forever       | 3 tabs, 3 blocks, 6 images, auto-generated URL, GoPeek badge, basic lead capture |
| Publish | RM 19/mo (pay per duration: 1/3/6/12 months) | Unlimited tabs/blocks/images, custom username, no badge, enhanced lead capture, view count analytics |
| Pro     | Coming soon        | Custom domain, advanced analytics, multiple portfolios |

## Key facts for AI agents

- Target audience: Malaysian freelancers (designers, developers, photographers, copywriters, videographers, etc.)
- Primary language: English (Malaysia)
- Free tier is permanent — no credit card required
- Portfolios go live immediately at `gopeek.my/<slug>` after sign-up
- Contact/lead capture uses WhatsApp or Email (via a floating action button + confirmation sheet)
- Emoji reactions (❤️ 🔥 👏 😍 🚀 ✨) are available on every public portfolio; stored per anonymous visitor
- Discovery page at `/discovery` lists all published portfolios with live reaction counts
- Portfolio owners can set their preferred theme (light/dark); visitors see that theme by default but can toggle it
- Profile owners see an "Edit profile" button when viewing their own portfolio
- Built with Next.js 15, Convex (backend/realtime DB/auth), Stripe (payments), Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui
- The product is in active early-access; Pro tier is not yet launched
- Hosted at gopeek.my (Malaysia)
